message.name: ABILITY_ARMOR_DESCR
message.value: Boxer gets protection from physical attacks +{valueDefenseFrom}-{valueDefenseTo}%. The percentage of protection increases with the level of boxer.

message.name: ABILITY_ENCOURAGING_ROAR_DESCR
message.value: At start of squad member's turn, increase their attack by {valueAdditionTo} until end of turn. Decreases mimicry duration towards allied units by 4 turns.

message.name: ABILITY_UNDERWATER_DESCR
message.value: A Demon can't drown as long as he's got something to stand on.

message.name: ABILITY_UNDERWATER_SQUAD_DESCR
message.value: At start of its turn and also at the start the battle, Demon temporarily grants each squad's unit ability to breathe underwater until that unit takes its turn. If unit's attack is less or equal to their armor stat, they get 2 turns of breath. Ability ignores turn switcher.

message.name: ABILITY_SPEED_DESCR
message.value: Rabbits get +{speed} speed, +{valueJumpPowerBonus} jump power and additional jump in air. When you press SHIFT and jump key at the same time, Rabbit does a powered jump.

message.name: ABILITY_REGEN_DESCR
message.value: When a Rabbit has less than {valueThreshold}% health, they start nibbling carrots at the beginning of each turn of the enemy team, restoring {valueHealFrom}-{valueHealTo} hp, depending on the initial health.

message.name: ABILITY_GENEROSITY_DESCR
message.value: When Rabbit passes an ally having less than {valueFriendly}% health, rabbit shares a healing carrot with them. Allies can also approah rabbit themselves to get a carrot.

message.name: ABILITY_REVENGE_DESCR
message.value: After the death of the Zombie, the charge of negative energy is released upon its killer, dealing 30 damage and poisoning for 10 turns.

message.name: ABILITY_REVIVAL_DESCR
message.value: Enemies killed by the Zombie rise from their graves to battle against former comrades. Revived zombies have darker color and no racial bonuses. Revived zombie has 0 armor, maximum attack and {hpEachLevelValue} health per level. For each zombie revived this way, once per battle you can pass the turn onto it or away from it for free (without spending a turn switcher charge from your arsenal); with no charges in your arsenal the free switch is unavailable, and further switches spend charges as usual (zombies from zombie March and resurrection seal excluded).

message.name: ABILITY_MASS_REVIVAL_DESCR
message.value: Everyone in squad, except revived zombies, gets abilities "Revenge from the grave" and "Uprising from the grave". Revived by squad units zombie has 0 armor, maximum attack and {massiveHpEachLevelValue} health per level.

message.name: ABILITY_CLIMBING_DESCR
message.value: Cats are able to climb walls and ceiling. Press the jump button twice to catch hold. Also Cats get increase speed +{valueClimbingSpeed} in this state.

message.name: ABILITY_PHASING_DESCR
message.value: When Cat is below {valueHpPercent}% health, they get {valueChance}% chance to evade most attacks. Every successful evasion increases Cat's attack value by {valueAddAttack} until the end of the battle (max +{valueMaxAttack}). Cat also dodges all attacks from the allies. This dodge works independently from dodge, granted by Cat's equipment.

message.name: ABILITY_SHARP_CLAWS_DESCR
message.value: When Cat and their party deal {valueDamageThreshold} or more damage to an enemy, they cause bleeding wounds on enemies (only the unit who started turn gets this ability). Damaged enemies take an additional {valueInDamagePercent}% (+1% for each allied unit at the start of the battle) of wounding damage (up to {valueLimitDamage}) over {valueTurnDuration} turns. Bleeding is treated treated with bandage and doctor bag.

message.name: ABILITY_FLYING_DESCR
message.value: Dragon can soar in the air, gliding over long distances. To take off, press the jump button twice.

message.name: ABILITY_FIERY_PACE_DESCR
message.value: The dragon leaves a trail of embers (up to {valueEmbers}), that ignite on the next turn, burn until {valueTurns} turns and can damage the enemy by {valueDamage} hp. Though embers deal fire damage, they cannot unfreeze enemies.

message.name: ABILITY_HEALING_EMBER_DESCR
message.value: When allies end their turn in Dragon's fire, they restore {valueHeal} hp and get +{valueAttackOnHeal} attack until the end of the battle (up to +{valueMaxAttack}), as well as get unfrozen. Units can get bonus from not more than three embers per turn.

message.name: ABILITY_DROID_DESCR
message.value: Personal protective droid, which is created at the beginning of Robot's turn and operates until its next turn. In 3 seconds after detecting an enemy, the droid emits an electrical charge that damages enemy by {valueDroneDamage}. A droid can be destroyed by any explosion.

message.name: ABILITY_SHOCK_DESCR
message.value: Deals {valueDamage} shock damage to enemies near the Robot. Also counterattacks enemies in close range after receiving more than {valueCounterThreshold} damage, dealing {valueCounterDamage} shock damage.

message.name: ABILITY_BATTLE_ANALYSE_DESCR
message.value: When dealing at least {valueMinDamage} damage to enemies, Robot and members of its squad reduce their armor by {valueReduceFrom}-{valueReduceTo} for {valueTurnDuration} turns. Maximum reduction is reached at {valueMaxDamage} damage.

message.name: ABILITY_DESTROYER_DESCR
message.value: Rhino can perform powerful stomp, that deals up to {valueDamage} damage and destroys the ground, activated by the jump button in the air. The efficiency depends on the Rhino's level, speed, and additional jump bonuses. Destruction radius decreased by 3 times if used under water, unless Rhino has water breathing. Stomp power also decreases with each application, a total of {valueStomps} per battle can be made.

message.name: ABILITY_RESIST_DESCR
message.value: Natural ability to survive in harsh conditions, providing +{valueResists}% protection from fire, cold and shock. Also gives +{fortitude} weighting protecting against pushback from attacks.

message.name: ABILITY_DEFENDER_DESCR
message.value: As long as the Rhino is alive, {valuePart2} part some of its defensive bonuses are extended to squad, but allied Rhinos will only receive {valuePart1} some of the bonuses.

message.name: ABILITY_INVULNERABLE_DESCR
message.value: Upon receiving fatal damage, the Alien stays alive with 1 hp and becomes immune to all damage unitl their next turn.

message.name: ABILITY_BONUS_FUEL_DESCR
message.value: Increases fuel of such weapons as Flying saucer, helicopter, boars, and jetpack by {bonusFuel}% and duration of such devices as blockers, grounding bot, force field and projector by {deviceDuration} turns.

message.name: ABILITY_ELEMENTS_WEAKNESS_DESCR
message.value: At the beginning of team's turn takes away {valueWeakness}% of defenses from fire, cold, shock, and air strikes from all enemies (defense can't become less than zero). Each elemental attack on the target restores {valueRestore} of lost corresponding defense ({valueRestoreFire} for fire protection), up to the initial value. At the end of the turn dissolution disappears completely.

message.name: ABILITY_FARTER_DESCR
